messages:
Megan: Quick sync — Q3 console visibility scope triage. Need final cut by EOD Friday. Main buckets: dashboards, traces, error analytics, retention sampling.

Derek: Can we drop 'full trace search' from v1? heavy infra cost and long lead time.

Ana: +1. Keep narrow query filters and strict perf KPIs. Propose sample rates per env: prod 5%, staging 20%.

Priya: Customer ask from FinCorp: wants 90d trace retention + audit logs. That's enterprise-only and will affect pricing.

Leo: Support backlog shows 3 customers requesting per-route cost breakdown in dashboard (billing visibility).

Carl: UX note — combined error + trace view needs minimal clicks. Uploaded quick mock: https://internal.mock/visibility/v1 (will add final frames).

Megan: Proposed triage for Q3: 1) per-route cost card on dashboard, 2) trace sampling controls in console, 3) error grouping + one-click trace link, 4) retention tiers (30/90/365). Which of these are must-ships?

Derek: Must: 1 & 3. Sampling controls can be beta behind a flag. Retention tiers require infra + billing changes -> stretch goal.

Ana: If we build an intelligent sampling layer (dynamic by latency/error) we can meet FinCorp's effective retention without full 90d storage. Needs an eval though.

Priya: For error grouping launch criteria: false discovery rate <5% on regression detection and trace link latency <200ms. Also need an eval harness with labeled regressions.

Megan: Drafting launch criteria now. Quick checklist:
```
Launch criteria v1:
- Dashboard: per-route cost card + filters
- Error analytics: group by stack frame, show aggregated counts, link to trace
- Trace sampling UI: set sample rate + target error capture
- Perf SLOs: dashboard query 95th <= 300ms
- Infra: retention options published as tiers + billing codes
- CS readiness: 2 customer pilots confirmed
```

Leo: I'll line up two pilot customers: FinCorp (security review) and Shoply (SaaS usage patterns).

Derek: Need concrete tickets: infra(retention tiers), api(cost-by-route), frontend(cards + UX), runtime(sampling control). I'll post estimates tomorrow.

Megan: Action items: Derek deliver scoping doc by Wed, Ana evaluate sampling perf by Thu, Carl produce 2 mocks by Wed. @everyone add blockers here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New RFC created: rfc/visibility-q3-1932104567

Priya: Flag — any compliance implications for 90/365 retention? Ping security + legal for a quick take.

Megan: Thanks — I'll sync with legal after Derek posts the infra scope. If we can convert FinCorp to pilot with intelligent sampling + 90d effective retention, we may avoid big infra lift.

Derek: noted — I'll include cost delta estimates for 30/90/365 in the scoping doc.

Carl: I'll attach the hi-fi mock by EOD tomorrow and add a short interaction spec.

Megan: Great. We'll reconvene Friday 9am PT for final scope sign-off.
